column1: # GI-12 CODE-PIN MAP — the INPUT of scripts/gen-code-pins.py. NOT AN AUTHORITY.
# WHAT THIS IS. The su0 semantic map, as both review engines approved it: one row
# per refusal-witness manifest row (122 `reject` + 2 `skip`), saying which stable
# code that row's refusal carries and, where the code has several witnesses,
# which fragment of the PRIMARY header's payload tells this row apart. The
# generator reads it once and writes column 4 of every reject/skip row of
# WHAT IT IS NOT. After the cutover the MANIFEST is the authority, and nothing
# compares the manifest against this file: a gate that did would make two files
# answer one question. Edit a pin in the manifest and this file goes stale
# without anything going red — that is by design, and it is why the generator
# re-measures every payload from the compiler instead of trusting what is
# written here. Re-run the generator only to re-derive pins wholesale, and read
#   code  condition  witnesses  row  class  param_dep  witness_tag
# `code=PD####` (a single-witness code, or a row tagged IDENTICAL because its
# payload is character-identical to a sibling's). The generator refuses to emit
# unless every one of those statements is true of the CURRENT compiler.
